![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14196548/assets/5018652c7049be48f998af2ceac522f4170475b1e5f5ed6b2daf77d1443eab27.svg)
question.worked_solution:
For a function $f: \mathbb R^n \to \mathbb R,$ given by
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14196548/assets/9ecc6bbb35ec3b1fc94b49a9da87099480dccbf63447ecd18b812547110b35ef.svg)

the second derivative of $f$ is given by the $n\times n$ matrix

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14196548/assets/92a91186756bb96fcf826be1ac0819b1a1fc7660cbf8ebff300d6e9390f90416.svg)

In our case, we have

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14196548/assets/4a0d68e1fb2aa93a6e7606cf7c96dcf692d366a0571c36e589810a4276572339.svg)

First, notice that since ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14196548/assets/b93095604beb468dac2fd708fa679379fdcdf273be6ae6a74517ec605e96a88b.svg) 
 we must have

$$
\dfrac{\partial f}{\partial x} = e^y\cos x ,  
\qquad 
\dfrac{\partial f}{\partial y} =e^y\sin x .
$$

Now, we compute the second partial derivatives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}^{2}} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}({e}^{y}\operatorname{cos}⁡x)=-{e}^{y}\operatorname{sin}⁡x\, & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂x∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}({e}^{y}\operatorname{sin}⁡x)={e}^{y}\operatorname{cos}⁡x \\ \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂y∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}({e}^{y}\operatorname{cos}⁡x)={e}^{y}\operatorname{cos}⁡x\, & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{y}^{2}} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}({e}^{y}\operatorname{sin}⁡x)={e}^{y}\operatorname{sin}⁡x\end{aligned}
$$

So, the second derivative is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{″}(x,y) & =[\begin{aligned}-{e}^{y}\operatorname{sin}⁡x & {e}^{y}\operatorname{cos}⁡x \\ {e}^{y}\operatorname{cos}⁡x & {e}^{y}\operatorname{sin}⁡x\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate this matrix at $(\pi,0).$ This gives

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14196548/assets/168592a2f48649e0cd90aa5226a55204435a02477b9f54f09fc22db32327d7b1.svg)
